violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CDI: CFM showed up during inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the handwashing sink near the 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: CFM provided hand soap at the handwashing sink near the 3 vat sink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shelled eggs stored above bulk RTE pickles container inside the walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated raw shelled eggs to another shelf (not above any other food items) inside the walk in refrigerator.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cider slaw 46F (overfilled pan) inside Atosa 3 Dr preptop in the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM portioned half of the cider slaw into another metal pan and transferred both pans of cider slaw to the walk in refrigerator to cool to 41F or below.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials (two chemical spray bottles) are not properly labeled with a common name.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: CFM placed common food label on the two chemical spray bottles on shelf in main kitchen. HANGRY JOES (Inspection Date: 09/28/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: plastic squeeze bottles (brown/ soy sauce, water, oil)
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS instructed CFM to label all food items removed from the original container.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink by in the ware washing area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC REPLACED THE PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the cook line being used to store equipment
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC REMOVED EQUIPMENT FROM HAND SINK.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CFM WAS NOT PRESENT AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED BEFORE THE END OF THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: nacho cheese 87F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED NACHO CHEESE.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed rice scoop stored in rooms temperature water and kinked stored in between equipment.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC MOVED KNIFE AND DUMPED WATED.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no cover to the feminine napkin refuse container in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.
